description: Public API definitions for SDIO subsystem, including function prototypes for initializing, enabling, configuring, and data transfer operations with SDIO cards.

methods.name: sdio_init_func
methods.description: Initializes an SDIO card function with specified card and function number.

methods.name: sdio_enable_func
methods.description: Enables a previously initialized SDIO function.

methods.name: sdio_set_block_size
methods.description: Sets the block size for an SDIO function.

methods.name: sdio_read_byte
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified SDIO register.

methods.name: sdio_write_byte
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified SDIO register.

methods.name: sdio_rw_byte
methods.description: Writes a byte to a register and reads back the register value.

methods.name: sdio_read_fifo
methods.description: Reads multiple bytes from an SDIO FIFO register.

methods.name: sdio_write_fifo
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to an SDIO FIFO register.

methods.name: sdio_read_blocks_fifo
methods.description: Reads multiple blocks from an SDIO FIFO register.

methods.name: sdio_write_blocks_fifo
methods.description: Writes multiple blocks to an SDIO FIFO register.

methods.name: sdio_read_addr
methods.description: Copies bytes from an SDIO card starting at a specific address.

methods.name: sdio_write_addr
methods.description: Copies bytes to an SDIO card starting at a specific address.
